tasks.completion_summary: Fixed orphaned processes surviving daemon restart by preserving PID tracker across graceful stops instead of clearing it. Added 2 e2e tests for PID tracker persistence and port cleanup on autostart.

Fixed Windows UI deadlock on panel close by removing termOverlay.Redraw() from the OutputGate onUnfreeze callback in run_windows.go. hideMenu holds overlay.mu when calling gate.Unfreeze(), and Redraw() also locks overlay.mu, causing a deadlock. The callers already handle redrawing after Unfreeze returns.

Fixed stale process panel header by syncing ProcessState from daemon status on each 750ms refresh tick, forcing full redraw when state changes so header reflects current running/failed state instead of stale failure from previous attempt.

Fixed ready signaler timeout by signaling readiness for already-running scripts during idempotent autostart, adding immediate port check in StartPortProbe to detect already-bound ports without 500ms delay, and adding dependency_ready logging for clear dependency satisfaction tracking.

Added ASCII spinner animation to status bar during panel-to-main transition. Spinner starts when overlay closes and stops when UpdateStatus delivers real content. Uses cross-platform ASCII characters (|/-\) at 200ms intervals.

Added loading page for proxy startup: when upstream returns connection refused or transient error, browser requests get a styled HTML page with spinner, live timer, and 3-second meta-refresh that seamlessly transitions to real content when server starts. API requests still receive plain-text errors.

Added 4 e2e tests for PID tracker persistence and crash recovery: file format validation (JSON structure with daemon_pid, processes, updated_at), graceful stop file preservation (file persists with processes removed individually), crash retention (processes retained in pids.json after context cancel), and atomic writes (always-valid JSON during rapid 4-process autostart, no leftover .tmp files).

Added TestE2E_ProcessTree_DeepNesting for 3-level deep process tree cleanup (sh->sh->sh->sleep). Skipped SetsidGrandchild_OrphanRecovery (covered by ForkDetach_DaemonCrash) and MultipleScripts_SharedCleanup (covered by OrphanCleanup_DaemonCrash) as redundant with existing tests.
